items.title: ESMO26: GSK’s Mo-Rez seeks an edge in a crowded ADC field in ovarian cancer
items.summary: GSK’s Mo-Rez is projected to reach global annual sales of $540m by 2032 based on GlobalData’s analyst consensus forecast.

items.title: ESMO26: Oral cell cycle inhibitors place Cyclin E1 as new target in PROC
items.summary: Data for the two PROC candidates that act on Cyclin E1 were presented at ESMO26.

items.title: US targets Chinese biotech investment, but licensing deals remain exempt
items.summary: Numerous types of equity deals involving Chinese biotech, including the popular NewCo model, will be impacted by the proposed rule.

items.title: Egypt reforms obsolete pharmaceutical pricing framework
items.summary: In late September 2026, the Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) published Decree No.480 of 2026 in the Official Gazette.

items.title: Gilead spends $1.28bn on PepStar’s potential Icotyde rival
items.summary: Gilead plans to develop HCXT-2001 both as a monotherapy and in combination with its own IBD hopeful, emvistegrast.
